clips.title: The story
paras: At the Angerfang Encampment, renegade Dragonmaw orcs provide sturdy shinbones for armor. In the Undercity, Velora Nitely needs them to frame leg guards for warriors.

Velora Nitely needs bones that can bear the strain of brutal leg guards. The renegade Dragonmaw orcs at the Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands have thick, sturdy frames, and their shinbones can brace the armor. Each bone must be tested by hand. Warriors discard any that snap under pressure.
